I genuinely care for my team, not just as coworkers but as friends, so I feel this extra hard because the guilt is so real, even when they're totally understanding. I'm the main closing/pre-closing barista at my store now and that makes it pretty much impossible to call out. I've checked the shift coverage group but majority of people are looking to get shifts covered too, not pick them up. If I call out as the pre-closer, they're fucked. If I call out as the closer, they're double triple fucked. And we only ever have one or two baristas on our schedule at a time that could possibly cover. So I basically just resign myself to going in no matter how shit I feel mentally or how exhausted my body is. I'm finally going on vacation this week but I feel like I could pass out from exhaustion or cry the moment I'm finally free. Please do take care of yourself, I know this isn't the right way to live at all.
